subheadline: Tatum scored 28 in the first half and finished with 41, eight assists and six rebounds as the Celtics beat Washington 131-116 in NBA Cup play.
description: Jayson Tatum scored 41 points with six threes as Boston beat Washington 131-116 to stay unbeaten in NBA Cup play. Why his Celtics No. 0 is a jersey to own now.
searchIntent: Celtics fans who saw Tatum's 41-point night want the key numbers and the right No. 0 jersey.
body: Jayson Tatum scored 41 points as Boston beat Washington 131-116 on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at Capital One Arena. He did most of the damage early, with 28 points by halftime, and finished 13-for-25 from the field and 6-for-15 from three, with eight assists and six rebounds.
The win ended a four-game losing streak for the Celtics, who moved to 12-6 and stayed unbeaten in NBA Cup group play.
## Why fans are buying in

A 41-point night means more coming from Tatum right now. He missed most of last season after surgery on a torn Achilles tendon and did not make his season debut until March 2026. Nights like this one are the clearest sign yet that the player who led Boston to the 2024 title is back to carrying the offense.

It also came when the team needed it. Boston had dropped four straight before Tuesday, and Tatum set the tone with a first half that put the Celtics up 80-49 at the break. Paul George added 28 points and nine assists, giving Boston a scoring pair that can trouble any defense.

His jersey already has a published track record. On the NBA and NBPA list of top-selling jerseys for the 2025-26 regular season, based on online sales through the NBA Store and Fanatics from Oct. 1, 2025 to April 12, 2026, Tatum ranked seventh, even though he played only the final weeks of that season.

The banner above shows his No. 0 in the kelly green Icon Edition, the white Association Edition and the black Statement Edition. Green and white is one of the most recognizable looks in basketball, and the black Statement jersey is a sharper choice for fans who want something different.
## Why this jersey will last

In our analysis, Tatum is the face of the franchise for the rest of the decade, and a full return to form makes his No. 0 the safest Celtics pick there is. Boston hosts Atlanta on Friday with a chance to keep its NBA Cup run going.

title: Paul George: 2,500 Career 3-Pointers in a Celtics Win
subheadline: George became the eighth player in NBA history to make 2,500 threes, finishing with 28 points and nine assists in a 131-116 win at Washington.
description: Paul George became the eighth NBA player to make 2,500 career threes, scoring 28 with nine assists in Boston's 131-116 win at Washington. Why his No. 13 works.
searchIntent: Fans following Paul George's climb up the all-time 3-point list want the milestone facts and a look at his Celtics jersey.
body: Paul George made his 2,500th career 3-pointer on Tuesday, Nov. 24, in Boston's 131-116 win at Washington. NBA.com noted that he is only the eighth player in league history to reach that mark.
He finished with 28 points on 11-for-20 shooting, went 6-for-9 from three and added nine assists. Boston outscored Washington by 34 points with him on the floor.
## Why fans are buying in

George is in his first season in Boston, and he has made it memorable from the start. In his Celtics debut on Oct. 20 he scored 38 points, the most ever by a player in his first game for the franchise, according to NBA.com. That same night he passed Kyle Korver for eighth place on the all-time 3-point list.

The next name above him is Reggie Miller, who finished his career with 2,560 threes. In our view, passing a Hall of Famer is within reach this season, and every three he makes from here moves him closer.

He is also a big part of why Boston is winning. Tuesday's victory ended a four-game skid, and George and Jayson Tatum combined for 69 points. In our analysis, a veteran star chasing history on a new team is exactly the kind of story that brings fans to a fresh jersey. That is our view, not a sales figure; George does not appear on a published NBA jersey list in our records.

## Why this jersey will last
Milestone seasons tend to stick in fans' memories, and this one could include a climb into the all-time top seven. A No. 13 Celtics jersey marks the year he did it in green.

body: Jack Eichel scored twice as Vegas beat Edmonton 5-3 on Tuesday, Nov. 24, at Rogers Place. His power-play goal at 6:13 of the first period opened the scoring, and his second, early in the third, put the Golden Knights ahead 4-2.
## Why fans are buying in

Eichel came into the night leading Vegas with 31 points, nine goals and 22 assists, according to the team's pregame notes, and he was riding a four-game point streak. Two more goals stretched that streak to five games and pushed him to 11 goals and 33 points.

The win mattered for the whole team. Vegas had lost four straight before this week, and beating the Oilers on the road made it two wins in a row and moved the Golden Knights to 15-6-5. Trevor Connelly added two goals and an assist, and Mitch Marner set up two goals, reaching 600 career assists in his 762nd game.

Eichel has been the center of this franchise since he arrived, and he has the résumé to back it up. He won the Stanley Cup with Vegas in 2023 and put up 90 points in 74 games last season. In our analysis, that steady production is why his jersey is the first one many Golden Knights fans reach for.
